title: Jardín de Datos
techniques: one 48x56 border module repeated on all four sides with <use>
catmull-rom tubes for stems, vines and cable
local-space clipPaths so the solar-cell grid sits inside the leaf
soft sky gradient, otherwise flat fills only
statement: I drew the hardware as the plant rather than beside it: the leaves are solar panels whose cell wiring is their venation, the flower is a satellite dish with its paraboloid rings and its LNB standing up out of the petals, the roots are a cable mat, and the seed in the third inset is a cut cable end whose strands splay like roots. The plate form — border, specimen, three details, cartouche — is the argument, not a frame: this is a plant catalogued by the same apparatus that catalogs the country. The gardener is half-eaten by the thing he maintains, which is the only sentence the picture needs.
